TC-19/S23.title: Phone 2 days back in UTC-10: Save & Extract a hold; the Held tag's date (last line of S23)
TC-19/S23.detail: Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Our addition (10-15 review), but data is lost, so it counts. Typed 'Hold lisinopril, BP soft.' + Save & Extract on a phone set two days back in Pacific/Honolulu (the hold answered at the socket). The phone shows 'Held · Oct 12' (its own date; the server's day is Oct 14 UTC / Oct 15 JST) and medicationsUpdatedAt was stored as 2026-10-12. When the correctly set web device then opened the chart, the lisinopril row was gone from the server and the web showed no Held tag at all. This is known B18 ('with a phone two days slow a held drug is stamped two days back and the next cleanup deletes it'). Left: dictating the S07/S08 medication changes with a real voice on real phones (transcription accuracy, engine).
TC-19/S23.productIssue: A hold entered on a phone whose date is two days behind is stamped two days back; the next time a correctly set device opens the chart the held medication disappears from the tracker (known B18).
